The reply says the question is unresolved because the reports conflict. It does lean toward 310, saying that figure is "somewhat better supported." But it frames the matter as undetermined and stops short of giving 310 as the answer. Its stated confidence of 35 is also low.

The deciding question is whether the reply commits to B. It opens with "Unresolved" and then only calls B somewhat better supported, which is a lean and not a commitment. So the reply does not pick one.
